text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our direct message. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18) weren't getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support.

Moss's other two notes on the account have no ticket numbers: the 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and the 2026-03-23 renewal check-in. #4409 and #4412 come from Moss's Central notes and belong to a different account, Marrow Fieldworks, not Quarrendon.

I also warned Dana that the account profile lists a separate ticket, **#4912**, for slow reporting at the Superior yard. It isn't from Moss's notes, and its number is easy to mix up with #4419.

I only used files Dana can see herself, and nothing in the reply is a finance figure.
